author: Inside Edition
description: A model of a Boeing jet suffered a catastrophic failure during a public event. Officials with the National Archives Museum were sharing news of the upcoming Freedom Plane National Tour. They unveiled the model of the plane – the one that will carry those founding documents – to applause, and held it up for all to see. Then, disaster struck, as the plane's wing fell off. The actual Freedom Plane will visit eight cities across the country, from March through August of this year.
title: 'Freedom Plane' Model Breaks During Announcement

author: Inside Edition
description: An intense manhunt is underway following the attempted assassination of a judge and his wife. Judge Steven Meyer and his wife were wounded by shotgun blasts in the brazen attack at their home in Lafayette, Indiana. Both are in stable condition and expected to recover, but the shooting has triggered fears for the safety of other judges across the nation. Meyer has presided over several high-profile cases.
title: Manhunt Underway Following Attempted Assassination Of Indiana Judge

author: Inside Edition
description: On the way home from Monday night's college football championship, Trump fired off a flurry of provocative social media posts, including a meme of him planting the stars and stripes on Greenland. He also posted a photoshopped image of a map showing the US flag covering both Greenland and Canada. People in Denmark have started wearing a red hat that reads "Make America Go Away." Trump is traveling to Switzerland Wednesday for a speech at the World Economic Forum.
title: Trump Posts Fake Picture Of Him Planting US Flag On Greenland

author: Inside Edition
description: Police allege Timothy Busfield "engaged in unlawful sexual conduct with twin brothers" on the set of "The Cleaning Lady." He denies the allegations The twins initially told police in 2024 that Busfield did not touch them inappropriately, according to an audio file released by Busfield's defense lawyers in an attempt to establish his innocence. Prosecutors say that in recent months, after the boys underwent therapy, they changed their statements and said Busfield touched them inappropriately.
title: New Audio Released In Timothy Busfield's Child Sex Abuse Case

author: Inside Edition
description: David Beckham remained silent as he was peppered with questions after his son declared, "I do not want to reconcile with my family." The soccer legend's eldest son Brooklyn took to Instagram to say his mom "hijacked" his lavish 2022 wedding to model and actress Nicola Peltz. On Tuesday when asked about the dangers of social media by young children, David Beckham said, "Children are allowed to make mistakes. That's how they learn," and, "You have to sometimes let them make those mistakes."
title: David Beckham Responds After Son Brooklyn's Bombshell Post

author: Inside Edition
description: A driver spotted six abandoned puppies on the side of the road. The rambunctious pups appeared to be just weeks old. The good Samaritan scooped them all out and put them in his truck. The driver, Steven Purcell, who lives in Canton, Texas, spoke with Inside Edition. Purcell took the puppies to the vet where they were found to be in good health. When it was time to put them up for adoption, Purcell made a video introducing each one. All six puppies were adopted.
title: Texas Man Saves 6 Abandoned Puppies From Side Of Road

author: Inside Edition
description: It's a new twist on the red hat. While many in the US say Make America Great Again, this one being sold in Denmark has a different message. It reads "Nu get Nuuk," which translates from Danish to English as, "Now it's enough." It's a direct response to President Trump's statements about taking Greenland, which is part of the Kingdom of Denmark. Many people see the comments as threatening and are fighting back. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Protestors In Denmark Wear Red Ball Caps With Messages Supporting Greenland
